source_description_html:
WRS creates the best windscreens using cutting edge technology. Using a physic simulator software WRS is able to reach the highest aerodynamic performance while keeping the windscreen designed to flow with the design of the motorcycle.

WRS is the technical supplier of Pramac Ducati MotoGP and the BMW Motorad WSBK team. Made from Poly Methyl Methacrylate (PMMA) or plexiglass in short form, these windscreens are DOT626 certified and only 2mm thick.
Using this special 2mm plexiglass allows the windscreens to maintain a lightweight and excellent flexibility properties which results in a windscreen that is much more impact resistant in the event of a fall or crash, and a windscreen that is lightweight as well. Available in clear or smoke grey colors. Made in Italy.
